{"language":"python","code":"from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('neuron_growth_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html')
s = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
lib = Path('.refio/dat.gui.min.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
inline = '<script>\n' + lib.replace('</script', '<\\/script') + '\n</script>'
pattern = r'<script\b[^>]*\bsrc=[\"\'][^\"\']*dat\.gui[^\"\']*[\"\'][^>]*>\s*</script>'
s, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: inline, s, flags=re.I)
if count == 0:
    s = s.replace('</head>', inline + '\n</head>', 1)
p.write_text(s, encoding='utf-8')
print('Embedded official dat.gui distribution in the HTML; no separate library file is required.')"}
